title: evaluation_result/v1
description: Canonical wire-contract schema for the claude CLI --json-schema flag when invoking the agent-retrospective evaluator Agent. Mirrors run_retrospective.py's Evaluation dataclass (WIRE_SCHEMA_EVALUATION = "evaluation_result/v1", Issue #2301). Issue #2362 (Scope Reframe, 2026-08-28 owner-approved): candidate_records[] entries are now a JUDGMENT-ONLY shape (candidate_id/title/description/claim_class/subject_ref/rule_id/evidence_refs) covering ONLY evaluator-authoritative fields -- identity/evaluations (history)/repository_id/source_run_ref/created_at/updated_at are deliberately NOT accepted here; run_retrospective.py's deterministic-enrichment phase (_enrich_candidate_record()) constructs those 100% from Python-side context (compute_finding_identity()/compute_delta()/PreviousStateProvider), never from this wire payload. This is a hand-authored draft-07 subset of the canonical agent_improvement_candidate/v1 schema (2020-12) -- deliberately not $ref'd across drafts, since the Agent SDK's --json-schema flag only accepts draft-07. The full per-record canonical validation (after Python-side enrichment has run) is enforced separately by run_retrospective.py's _validate_candidate_records().

claim_class.description: ADR 0007 Decision 2 claim-class taxonomy (exact 9-value closed enum) -- mirrors agent_improvement_candidate_v1.schema.json's $defs.claim_class. Kept in sync manually (draft-07 cannot $ref across the 2020-12 canonical schema).

subject_ref.description: Mirrors agent_improvement_candidate_v1.schema.json's $defs.subject_ref (discriminated union + pattern constraints), hand-authored here in draft-07 for the same reason as claim_class above.

evidence_ref_judgment.description: Judgment-only subset of agent_improvement_candidate_v1.schema.json's $defs.evidence_ref -- evaluator supplies ref_type/source_id/resource_identity for evidence it actually saw in observer output; projection_digest is deliberately NOT accepted here (run_retrospective.py's deterministic-enrichment phase recomputes it from the real observer finding_sets data it holds, never trusting an evaluator-supplied value).

candidate_judgment.description: Issue #2362: judgment-only wire shape for one candidate record. Deliberately does NOT accept identity/evaluations/repository_id/source_run_ref/created_at/updated_at/candidate_status -- those are 100% Python-side deterministic (see run_retrospective.py's _enrich_candidate_record()).
